meta.title: Hempstead County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Hempstead County's 2026 budget as filed with the state: the county's budget detail report ('Original Budget' column) and Appropriation Ordinance 2025-18. For two small grant funds where the two disagree, we used the ordinance amount. The county budgets $1,951,000.00 as transfers between its own funds, so those dollars appear in both funds.
